adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `destinationCalendar` is `null`, this optional-chained push becomes a no-op, so any `teamDestinationCalendars` collected from other hosts are silently not added. This matches the finding: the new “add other collective hosts’ destination calendars” logic fails exactly when the organizer/first host has no destination calendar configured.
